# Annotated checklist (read-only; no files reopened)

**A. Acquisition vs. representation.** All six completed reads are prior descriptive records, not fresh pixel observations; nothing was re-read here, and "image-A"–"image-F" are audit labels only.

**B. Per-item entries (observation / caveat).**
- **image-A:** red circle, left-of-center and above middle, label "A17" below. Caveat: red hue described qualitatively only.
- **image-B:** blue square, centered upper-middle, label "B28". Caveat: exact centering not measured.
- **image-C:** green upward triangle, centered, label "C39". Caveat: green described as medium-dark without comparison sample.
- **image-D:** purple plus/cross, centered, label "D40". Caveat: arm proportions not measured.
- **image-E:** orange/amber diamond, centered, label "E51"; label appears bold and slightly right of center. Caveat: weight/offset are visual impressions.
- **image-F:** black five-pointed star, point upward, centered, label "F62"; label appears bold. Caveat: same impression limitation.

**C. Field-parallel comparison (shape / color / text / position).** Distinguishing cue is legible identifier text in every pair; shape is an equally color-independent cue. Color alone cannot separate items if reproduction is degraded — text and silhouette still can. Shared composition (single solid flat shape, plain light background, identifier beneath) is stated separately and is not a discriminator.

**D. Evidence classes.** Direct observation: silhouettes, qualitative colors, transcribed identifiers. Interpretation: "bold," "slightly right of center," the suggested shared template. Unavailable: vector paths, authoring software, pixel values, metadata, production history.

**E. Conflicts.** No contradiction between the earlier exchange and these records is evident; no independent remeasurement was performed.

**F. Conclusion.** Each item is identifiable from documented geometry plus transcribed text; identification rests on the prior reads, not on new inspection, and is not an accessibility certification.

**G. Unresolved uncertainties.** Label weight/alignment on E and F; geometric proportions.

**H. Recommendations (not completed).** If publication needs exact positions or colors, take a measurement pass — deliberately not done here.
